newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - FLS sees excellent 1996 result. [CORRECTED 15:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - FLS sees excellent 1996 result. [CORRECTED 15:52 GMT]

text.p: Danish cement and engineering group FLS Industries A/S said on Monday it expected its full year 1996 net profit (corrects from pre-tax profit) to be the best in five years.

"If you forget extraordinary and one-off items, 1996 is going to be a much better year quality-wise than 1991. If you include everything, we expect to see a whole year 1996 pre-tax result at the same level as 1991," FLS managing director Birger Riisager told a business conference.
FLS posted a 643 million crown net (corrects from pre-tax) profit in 1991. In August it reported 207 million (corrects from 327 million) crown pre-tax profits for 1996's first six months.
At the same time it forecast "continued progress" in the year's second half.
FLS' ordinary pre-tax profit for the full year 1995 was 566 million crowns, with net profit at 412 million crowns.
Riisager said that he expected group turnover for 1996 of around 19.5 billion crowns compared with 1995's 18 billion crowns, half of it outside Europe.
He added that he expected the positive trend FLS Industries had experienced since 1993 to continue in 1997 and 1998.
